drawio_review_note: Aligned with VBench-2.0 arXiv:2503.21755, Sections 3-5; official Vchitect/VBench repository. VBench-2.0 shifts video-generation evaluation from superficial plausibility to intrinsic faithfulness. It defines five top-level dimensions—human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics, and commonsense—and decomposes them into fine-grained capabilities with tailored prompts. Candidate models generate videos for the frozen suites. Each capability uses an evaluator selected from generalist VLM/LLM judges or specialist anomaly and vision methods. Extensive human annotations calibrate and validate metric alignment. Results are aggregated at capability and dimension levels to reveal whether videos obey anatomy, composition, physical laws, prompt controls, and commonsense rather than merely looking smooth.
